svg.title: Classification of dyes by chemical structure
svg.desc: Tree of natural and synthetic dyes with synthetic classes grouped by chromophore: azo, anthraquinone, indigoid, triarylmethane and others
svg.text: Classification of dyes by chemical structure (chromophore)
Natural vs synthetic; synthetic dyes grouped by their chromophoric system
Indigo (Indigofera), alizarin (madder root), carminic acid (cochineal), lawsone (henna), curcumin (turmeric),
Methyl orange, Congo red, Sudan I, Para Red
C=C joining two indoxyl / thioindoxyl units
central C with three aryl rings (one quinoid)
ring containing N and N / O / S
four isoindole units round a metal (Cu) ion
Ar–CH=CH–Ar, often with azo / triazine units
